name: Brow Spark
description: Gather a spark at the brow and snap the head forward to throw it at the target.

name: Brow Glow
description: Kindle a steady glow at the brow that sharpens aim and clears the head.

name: Brow Guard
description: Flash the brow glow across a thrown missile to turn it from the face.

name: Brow Beam
description: Loose a narrow beam from the brow that burns through a raised guard.

name: Kindled Stare
description: Hold the stare on a foe while the brow glow weighs down their qi.

name: Brow Soothe
description: Touch the brow glow to an ally's head to ease a wound to the skull and clear the daze.

name: Brow Lance
description: Stretch the brow glow into a lance that bores through plate at the point of the stare.

name: Brow Nova
description: Burst the whole brow glow outward in a hard white ring that burns all within a short reach.

name: Kindled Gaze
description: Keep the gaze on one foe until the burning beam has pierced them and pinned their qi.

name: Dawn Gaze
description: Cast the school's gaze as one bar of light that burns wherever the eyes rest and as deep as the student's reserve allows.

name: Dawn Touch
description: Lay a hand glowing pale rose on an ally's cut and warm it closed.

name: Dawn Screen
description: Hold a pale rose ward before the wounded to blunt blows meant for them.

name: Dawn Sting
description: Rap a foe with a glowing knuckle that stings sharply and buys the healer a breath.

name: Dawn Purge
description: Draw the dawn light along a poisoned limb until the taint rises and burns away.

name: Dawn Tonic
description: Lift a drained ally's strength with a single pulse of cool dawn light through the chest.

name: Dawn Shield
description: Raise a standing wall of dawn light before a row of wounded and hold it through a strike.

name: Dawn Mantle
description: Wrap one badly hurt ally in a mantle that turns blows and mends flesh while it lasts.

name: Dawn Revival
description: Pour dawn light into one whose breath has just failed to restart the heart within a short window; it never returns the long dead.

name: Dawn Renewal
description: Bathe one ally in a full dawn that closes grave wounds and burns out taint together.

name: Daybreak Mercy
description: Let the school's wide mercy fall as a morning light on every ally in sight and mend each by as much as the reserve gives.

name: Prism Spark
description: Flick a spark through a hand-held prism so it breaks into a fan of small stings.

name: Prism Ward
description: Hold a prism of light before the chest so blows break up into harmless colour.

name: Prism Glance
description: Look through the prism of the field and read the colour of the qi in each figure.

name: Cut Facet
description: Cut one hard facet of light across the guard and into the arm beneath.

name: Prism Fan
description: Fan the prism wide to throw a spread of coloured beams across the whole front.

name: Prism Snare
description: Wind crossing beams round a foe's limbs so that they cannot be raised.

name: Prism Echo
description: Echo one flash into seven colours that fool the eye as to which is the true source.

name: Prism Burst
description: Burst the held prism in a shower of beams that rake the whole ground ahead.

name: Spectral Lance
description: Draw every colour into one bar and drive it through the foe's strongest guard.

name: Prism Burn
description: Hold a court of seven colours about the foes that burns them and bewilders their sense of direction.

name: Seven Beams
description: Cast the school's seven beams from seven angles to meet on one target with all the force the reserve can feed.

name: Core Glow
description: Feel the formed Core glow and let a thread of its light run to the hands.

name: Core Ray
description: Send a small ray from the Core outward through the palm.

name: Core Guard
description: Throw a disc of Core light before the chest to stop a hard blow.

name: Core Beam
description: Bore a narrow beam from the Core through a guard and its bearer.

name: Core Shield
description: Hold a broad shield of Core light that keeps its brightness against repeated blows.

name: Core Throb
description: Beat the Core once so a ring of light pulses outward and shoves back all near.

name: Core Spear
description: Draw the Core light into a spear and keep driving it as the foe retreats.

name: Core Eruption
description: Let the Core erupt in a column of light that rises and then falls on a wide patch.

name: Radiant Core
description: Raise the Core to full brightness so that it burns the ground and bows every foe on it.

name: Core Star
description: Spend the Core as a small star whose light falls and pierces by as much as the reserve can feed.

name: Bearing Glint
description: Throw a glint ahead along the bearing and feel what turns it aside.

name: Sworn Ray
description: Loose a ray along a sworn bearing so it keeps to its line through wind.

name: Ray Bearing
description: Step along the sworn line without a wobble and set the feet for the next ray.

name: Cross Beam
description: Cross two beams on the mark so they strike as one hard point.

name: Ray Return
description: Take a ray or missile on the forearm and send it back along its own line.

name: Beam Pace
description: Hold a steady pace of light about the legs that keeps stride and breath in order.

name: Bearing Beam
description: Hold a great beam on its bearing and let no turn of the foe pull it off the mark.

name: Sworn Volley
description: Loose a volley of rays that all keep the sworn bearing and arrive in one tight cluster.

name: Fixed Mark
description: Fix a mark of light on a foe that no step can shake and bind their movement to it.

name: Oath Ray
description: Cast a ray bound by oath to one mark that does not swerve and strikes with as much as the reserve feeds it.

name: Distant Glint
description: Throw a glint that keeps its sting over a long reach.

name: Beam Stride
description: Take one long reaching step and land with the lead hand already out.

name: Distance Gleam
description: Send a gleam far off and gauge how long a ray would take to cross it.

name: Span Beam
description: Fire a thin beam across a wide gap that arrives with no loss of force.

name: Long Guard
description: Hold a long slanted shield of light that covers the user on the run.

name: Stride Mend
description: Run beside an ally and keep a mending beam on their wound as they go.

name: Unbroken Beam
description: Hold one beam without a break while the user walks it across the foe's whole line.

name: Beam Leap
description: Leap along the beam and land a strike at its far end before the light has faded.

name: Straight Radiance
description: Widen the beam into a straight band of radiance that burns everything along its length.

name: Single Beam
description: Cast the school's line of light from the user to the far mark and burn all that stands on it.

name: Soft Glow
description: Let a plain glow spread round the user and thin the force of blows.

name: Aureole Spark
description: Spit a spark from the edge of the field at the nearest foe.

name: Aureole Feel
description: Feel the shape and weight of every body that crosses the edge of the field.

name: Aureole Wave
description: Send a wave of light outward from the field to burn and push back those nearby.

name: Aureole Veil
description: Draw the field into a bright curtain that stops arrows and thrown stone.

name: Aureole Sight
description: Spread the field out far and read every body by the way it bends the light.

name: Aureole Press
description: Press the field down on the foes within it until their qi sags and their steps drag.

name: Aureole Blaze
description: Raise the field to a long blaze that sears all within and keeps burning while held.

name: Aureole Seal
description: Seal every working of qi inside the field with a pressure of light so foes cannot cast.

name: Pure Radiance
description: Pour the whole open field down in a plain blaze that burns and presses all in its reach.

name: Unshadowed Aureole
description: Cast the school's field so wide and bright that no shadow remains and every foe in it burns by as much as the reserve gives.

name: Beacon Mote
description: Set a mote of light on the Core and feel what stirs in its glow.

name: Guiding Mote
description: Send a mote of light to an ally to steady their step and mark their path.

name: Keeper Guard
description: Throw up a quick guard of light for the one who tends the beacon.

name: Beacon Beam
description: Send a beam from the beacon into whatever comes too near it.

name: Core Lantern
description: Swing the Core as a lantern to show allies where every foe stands.

name: Beacon Rally
description: Pulse the beacon so every ally nearby feels their strength and nerve return.

name: Beacon Ward
description: Spread a ward of beacon light over the allies that turns blows and stays bright.

name: Beacon Burst
description: Flare the beacon so that its light burns every foe that stands near it.

name: Guiding Core
description: Let the Core guide the allies through the fight and strengthen and mend those in its light.

name: Core Beacon
description: Cast the school's beacon so that it lifts every ally in its light and bows every foe by as much as the reserve gives.
